user.title: Connect to K-Domo
user.description: Use your official K-Domo account. Only the plant you select will be imported. Controls start disabled. Credentials are stored in Home Assistant configuration.

plant.title: Choose a plant
plant.description: Import thermostats from this plant. No device settings will be changed.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the password for the existing account. If needed, complete privacy acceptance in the official app first.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication rejected. Check your K-Domo credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to K-Domo, or the cloud returned an unsupported response. Try again later.
error.privacy_required: Open the official K-Domo app and complete privacy acceptance first.
error.plant_unavailable: The selected plant is not accessible from this account.

abort.already_configured: This account and plant are already configured.
abort.no_plants: No plants are available on this account.

init.title: K-Domo options
init.description: Enable controls only when ready to use them. Commands preserve schedules. Temporary manual mode may end at a native schedule transition. A target change by itself preserves the current on/off status.
